quote: Janelle’s comedy was cheeky, funny, and very well received by my family and guests. Her songs had everyone laughing and she cleverly integrated Spudshed into her jokes to personalise her performance. A very entertaining local WA talent!
author: Tony Galati

quote: Tourism Malaysia engaged Janelle to host our roadshow event for honoured international government officials. She was at all times professional, engaging and flexible, kept the evening moving along, and her humour and specifically tailored material written for our event was a highlight of the evening.
author: Siti Hadijah Arifin

quote: Janelle was an absolute delight from start to finish, and the booking process was seamless. She had a crowd of 200 women laughing out loud with her clever comedy, quick wit, spontaneous jingles and fantastic audience interaction. She read the room beautifully and kept everyone entertained from beginning to end.
author: Bruce Rock Cultivators Committee Inc

quote: Janelle Koenig was the showstopper of the night, an absolute powerhouse who had the room in tears (the good kind!) with her razor-sharp humour and magnetic stage presence. We’re so grateful for her generosity, professionalism, and ability to connect with a diverse crowd.
author: Andy Fermo
